results.title: Trump underwater in 39 states, new poll shows

results.content:
Figures from Civiqs' rolling tracking poll of registered voters captured as of September 28 show the president is underwater in 39 states and every major battleground state.

Civiqs gives Trump a net approval rating in 10 states: Idaho, Wyoming, Utah, North Dakota, South Dakota, Kansas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Alabama and West Virginia.

Meanwhile, Civiqs puts the president’s overall approval rating at 34 percent.

results.content:
Polling from Civiqs’ rolling tracker shows that in Alabama, Trump maintains a net approval rating of +5, which stands in contrast to most other states where he has a net negative rating as the Iran war rages and Americans grapple with high prices.

Alabama Republican candidates are also choosing to attend his rally, which isn’t necessarily the case in battleground states this cycle, where GOP candidates could view the president as a liability rather than an asset.

results.title: Trump approval sags amid fight over press White House access

results.content:
President Donald Trump's approval rating among white voters in Florida has fallen to the edge of negative territory, a striking reversal in a state and demographic group that helped power his return to the White House.

Data displayed by the Civiqs public opinion tracker showed that 47% of white Floridians approved of Trump's job performance as of Sept. 17, while 46% disapproved. Another 7% said they neither approved nor disapproved. [...] At the beginning of Trump's second term, the Civiqs chart placed his approval among white Floridians above 60%, with disapproval in the mid-30s. The lines have moved steadily toward each other since then, leaving a gap of more than 25 points nearly erased.
results.title: Trump's Support Among White Floridians Nears a Historic Reversal
